notes.title: New Paintings and Painting History
notes.notes:
[p]There have been quite a few updates in the past few weeks. First up, several small QOL things like: better shadows everywhere, a blank canvas texture, additional painting descriptions, and scroll wheel functionality on the painting selection screen. Also...[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067134/ce4a0f87c2f62361c72ee50f0f6d8a624659cd00.png"][/img]

New Paintings![/h3][list][*][p]The Kiss, Gustav Klimt[/p][/*][*][p]The Death of Marat, Jacques-Louis David[/p][/*][*][p]The Swan, No. 17, Hilma af Klint[/p][/*][*][p]Suprematist Composition: Airplane Flying, Kazimir Malevich[/p][/*][/list][p]And finally... notes.title: New Painting Selection Screen
notes.notes: [p]This is my first Steam release, which means I'm learning things as I go, like the importance of updates! Thanks for bearing with me here. 😬[/p][p]I've been working on the game all summer, so wrapping all that up in one post or knowing where to start is completely overwhelming! Instead, I thought I'd highlight just one change... the new painting selection screen. Designing and implementing it took a while and I'm very happy with how it turned out.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067134/a63971ebc9aa9e7be8ed5930af96357ba33a2732.png"][/img][/p][h3]This includes:[/h3][list][*][p]A new list-based design that supports more paintings and easy updates[/p][/*][*][p]Painting details panel shows bigger painting, title, artist, dates, and description[/p][/*][*][p]Personal high and last scores per painting[/p][/*][*][p]The highest grade received on each painting (I implemented a grading system)[/p][/*][/list][p]We'll see if I keep these feature-focused, event-focused or they become more dev-loggy... regardless, more coming![/p]
